source: Relax, kid.
I said I'm fine.
You don't look fine.
Give me five minutes.
Fine. But we're leaving after that.
Don't make me regret this.
You worry too much.
And you don't worry enough.
Excuse me, Captain Gao.
The council is waiting for you.
Tell them I'll be there shortly.
translation: Onlara kısa süre içinde geleceğimi söyle.

source: With all due respect, Captain, we don't have time to wait.
translation: Saygı duyarak, Kaptan, bekleme vaktimiz yok.

source: Would you mind lowering your voice?
I heard you the first time.
Don't get the wrong idea.
I wasn't asking for permission.
My name is Luo Tian.
Have you seen Hu San?
I gave the map to Gao Yuan.
This sword belongs to Luo Tian.
We received a message from Mira Vale.
Tell Kael Arden I'm looking for him.
I haven't spoken to Young Master Yu since yesterday.
Take this directly to Young Master Yu.
We have to enter the Secret Realm before sunset.
Once we're inside the Secret Realm, stay close to me.
translation: Dün beri Genç Efendi Yu ile konuşmadım.

source: Your Mana Core is unstable.
Protect your Mana Core and don't force it any further.
translation: Bunu doğrudan Genç Efendi Yu'ya götür.

source: This Spirit Stone isn't worth much.
I paid three Spirit Stones for that map.
Only Inner Disciples are allowed beyond this gate.
translation: Gizli Diyar'a girdikten sonra yanımdan ayrılmayın.

source: The Inner Disciples' quarters are on the eastern side.
The Guild Master ordered us to retreat.
I need to speak with the Guild Master personally.
translation: Mana Çekirdeğini koru ve onu daha fazla zorlama.

source: You signed a Soul Contract, didn't you?
Breaking a Soul Contract has consequences.
He's not an Ability User.
Then how did he survive that attack?
The entrance to Blackwind Ravine is two miles north.
The Celestial Forge hasn't been used in nearly a century.
What about the chest?
Leave it. It's trapped.
But it could contain something valuable.
I said leave it.
He accused you of cheating.
translation: Peki o saldırıyı nasıl hayatta kaldı?

source: Leave it. It's not worth arguing over.
translation: Karayel Vadisi'nin girişi kuzeyde iki mil uzakta.

source: That's easy for you to say.
translation: Göksel Ocak neredeyse bir yüzyıldır kullanılmadı.

source: Maybe. But fighting him won't change anything.
They're going to charge us at dawn.
Then we'll hit them before they can form ranks.
translation: Ama içinde değerli bir şey olabilir.

source: How much did the merchant charge you?
More than this junk was worth.
Our party has six members.
Seven, if Luo Tian comes with us.
The victory party starts after sunset.
translation: Zafer partisi gün batımından sonra başlıyor.

source: Assuming we're still alive by then.
Great. The bridge collapsed.
Just what we needed.
Nice going, genius.
Oh, shut up. You were the one who said it was safe.
translation: Pekala, sus. Güvenli dediğin senin değil mi?

source: You've got some nerve blaming me.
Save the lecture for later.
This is not the time.
For once, we agree.
What the hell are you doing?
Trying to keep us alive!
Then move your damn hand!
translation: O zaman lanet olsun elini çek!

source: Shit. We're surrounded.
Don't push your luck.
I wasn't planning to.
You've said that before.
And I'm still alive, aren't I?
Wait—
Did you hear that?
No...
Not again.
Because if he finds us here...
Don't.
Don't what?
Don't finish that sentence.
Where's Master Lin?
They said they'd meet us here.
Maybe they changed their mind.
Or maybe something happened.
We don't know that.
Exactly. So stop guessing.
translation: Tam da öyle. O halde tahmin etmeyi bırak.

source: Did Ren take the artifact?
He didn't say he took it.
He said he saw who did.
That's not the same thing.
Everyone who enters the chamber is tested.
Not everyone who enters comes back.
Only two of the five seals have been broken.
We need all five before the gate will open.
translation: Kapı açılmadan önce beşini de tamamlamamız lazım.

source: At least three guards are still inside.
translation: En az üç gardiyam hala içeride.

source: We have no more than three minutes.
Unless the gate closes before midnight, we still have time.
translation: Kapı gece yarısından önce kapanmadıysa, hala zamanımız var.

source: If I had known what was waiting inside, I wouldn't have come.
Even if he apologizes, I won't trust him again.
translation: Özür dilesi bile olsa, ona tekrar güvenmeyeceğim.

source: If you leave now, I won't stop you.
But if you stay, you follow my orders.
Understood?
He almost killed me.
But he didn't.
I barely got away.
That's exactly why you shouldn't go back alone.
translation: Tam da bu yüzden tek başına geri gitmemelisin.

source: Three days.
That's all I need.
You said two days yesterday.
Things changed.
Funny how they always seem to change when you make a promise.
translation: Vaad ettiğinde her zaman değişiyorlar, ne garip.

source: Are you calling me a liar?
translation: Beni yalan söyleyen biri mi sayıyorsun?

source: One in ten recruits makes it this far.
translation: On yeniçeriden sadece biri bu kadar ilerleyebiliyor.

source: The third floor is twice as dangerous as the second.
translation: Üçüncü kat, ikinci katın iki katı kadar tehlikeli.

source: We lost twenty percent of our supplies.
This blade costs 2,500 Spirit Stones.
That's more than I earn in a year.
And it's still the cheapest one here.
translation: Ve yine de burada en ucuzu.

source: I don't need you to save me.
Good, because I wasn't going to.
translation: İyi ki, çünkü ben de yapmayacaktım.

source: ...You could at least pretend.
Would that make you feel better?
translation: Böylece daha iyi hissedersen ne olur?

source: No.
Maybe a little.
I hate you.
No, you don't.
Don't tell me how I feel.
Then stop looking at me like that.
translation: O halde bana öyle bakmayı bırak.

source: Like what?
Exactly.
You came back.
I said I would.
You also said you wouldn't do anything reckless.
translation: Ayrıca hiçbir şeyi tembel yapmayacağımı da söylemiştin.

source: I lied about that part.
Idiot.
Yeah. Probably.
The master told me to wait here.
Which master?
The Guild Master.
Oh. You could've said that first.
The core of the problem isn't your Mana Core.
It's that you refuse to listen.
Those are two completely different things.
Are they?
The seal on the eastern door is weakening.
Don't break it until the others arrive.
This letter bears the royal seal.
So it's genuine?
After the first alarm sounded, the guards sealed every exit except the northern passage.
translation: İlk alarm çaldıktan sonra, gardiyanlar kuzey geçidini hariç tutarak tüm çıkışları mühürledi.

source: By the time we reached it, someone had already destroyed the bridge.
That means whoever did this knew exactly where we were going.
translation: Bunun anlamı, bunu yapan kişi nereye gittiğimizi tam olarak biliyordu.

source: Or they wanted us to think they did.
translation: Ya da bizi öyle düşünmeye itmek istiyorlardı.

source: Luo Tian had expected the ruins to be empty, but the footprints in the dust were fresh.
translation: Luo Tian, kalıntıların boş olmasını beklemişti ama tozda ayak izleri taze idi.

source: Someone had entered the chamber recently, and whoever it was had taken great care not to disturb anything else.
translation: Kimse odanın içine son zamanlarda girmişti ve kim olursa olsun başka hiçbir şeyi rahatsız etmeye çok dikkat etmişti.

source: That bothered him more than a broken lock would have.
translation: Bunu, kırılmış bir kilitten daha çok rahatsız ediyordu.

source: A thief would have rushed. This person had been looking for something specific.
translation: Bir hırsız acele ederdi. Bu kişi ise belirli bir şey arıyordu.

source: The rain had stopped before dawn, yet the stone path was still slick beneath their feet.
translation: Yağmur şafak vaktinden önce durmuştu ama taş yol ayaklarının altında hala kaygan idi.

source: No one spoke as they climbed toward Blackwind Ravine.
The silence wasn't peaceful; it was the kind that made every distant sound seem closer than it really was.
translation: Sessizlik huzurlu değildi; her uzak sesi gerçekten daha yakın hissettiren türdendi.

source: When Gao Yuan finally raised his hand, everyone stopped at once.
translation: Gao Yuan sonunda elini kaldırdığında herkes birden durdu.

source: "You knew?"
"I suspected."
"That's not the same thing."
"It is when everyone else is dead."
I never said he was innocent.
You said there wasn't enough evidence.
There still isn't.
Then why are you carrying his sword?
Maybe he was right.
About what?
About me.
That's not an answer.
I can do this.
I know.
Then why are you stopping me?
Because being able to do something doesn't mean you should.
translation: "Çünkü bir şeyi yapabilme yeteneği, yapman gerektiği anlamına gelmez."

source: If the first team fails, the second team retreats.
translation: Birinci ekip başarısız olursa, ikinci ekip geri çekilir.

source: If the second team can't retreat, destroy the gate.
translation: İkinci ekip geri çekilemezse, kapıyı yok et.

source: And if we're still inside?
Then you'd better make sure the first team doesn't fail.
translation: O zaman birinci ekibin başarısız olmasını engellemeniz lazım.
